verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect control over where data lives. Local runs persist cookies and local storage in a user data directory you choose, Browserbase contexts are opt-in persistence, and session data can be kept in a required jurisdiction by region. Results are also cached server-side. Nothing documents retention periods, deletion of cached results or session recordings, or a data-deletion process. missing for 10: explicit retention policy/configuration, documented deletion of server-side caches, recordings and contexts, data-deletion APIs or controls, independent corroboration
